name: Learning to Ride

angles.text: As a night elf, mastering the ways of the saber is a proud rite of passage, letting you bond with the great cats of Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Jartsam trains seasoned adventurers in the Apprentice Riding skill required to mount a saber.
faq.q: Who teaches you how to ride a saber?

aliases: where do i get a saber
faq.answer: Lelanai provides a free mount once you have trained with Jartsam, and she offers additional mounts for sale afterward.
faq.q: Who gives you a mount once you finish training?

faq.answer: Different beasts across the world require their own distinct riding skills, each taught by their own trainers.
faq.q: Can you ride other creatures with this skill?

faq.answer: Riding a saber allows you to journey across the world far faster than traveling on foot.

sections.body: Jartsam considers you experienced enough to learn how to ride a saber, provided you can pay his training fee. Once you master the skill, Lelanai will grant you a mount without charge, opening the way to purchase others. Diverse beasts throughout the world demand their own training, but this instruction prepares you for long journeys across the wild lands.
sections.title: Taking the Reins

summary: Jartsam offers to teach you saber riding once you have gathered enough coin for his instruction. With this training complete, Lelanai will grant your first mount to carry you across distant lands.
attribution: In-game quest text: Learning to Ride
